app.name: Nemo Console
sys.loading_hint: The system is starting and is not down. A cold start can take several minutes; metrics appear once it is serving.
common.copy_failed: Copy failed; select the text manually
topbar.role_tip: Your role. Admin-only controls are disabled for viewers; the server enforces this too.
role.viewer_disabled: Admin only: your role is viewer or public (set a bearer token with the key button)
role.viewer_readonly: You are a viewer: this file is shown read-only.
auth.title: Bearer token
auth.explain: Paste an API key (run `nemo-console mint-key admin`; it prints the path of a 0600 key file, never the key). The token is kept in this tab's sessionStorage and is cleared when the tab closes.
overview.no_data: No overview data. Is the console backend running?
topo.aria: Topology graph: clients, relay, switchyard, litellm and engines. A text version follows.
topo.legend: Solid edges carry traffic; dashed edges are paths that are not active. Colour, symbol and text all show node health; ○ off means opt-in and stopped on purpose, not a fault.
routing.title: Routing decisions
routing.share_aria: {title}: share of requests as horizontal bars; each bar is labelled with its count and percentage
routing.name: Name
routing.no_data: No routed requests in this window.
routing.rate_aria: Requests per minute over the selected window
ev.empty_hint: Events appear here live. Only metadata is shown: never prompt or completion text.
cfg.no_files: This system has no configuration files.
cfg.readonly_default: Editing this file is a human security decision made outside the console.
cfg.apply_effect_default: Writes the new content to the file and may restart the service.
cfg.no_changes: There are no changes to apply.
cfg.fix_first: Validation reported errors. Fix them before applying.
cfg.confirm_base: Written only if {path} is still at sha256 {sha} (compare-and-swap).
cfg.confirm_backup: A backup revision is taken first. If the health check fails afterwards the backup is restored automatically.
cfg.discard_effect: Your unsaved edits in this editor are thrown away and the file is reloaded from disk.
diff.title: Changes against the current file
diff.none: No differences from the file on disk.
val.caveat: This validator is only a proxy for the real server, so a pass here does not guarantee the real server will accept the file.
val.caveat_short: Validation for this file is not authoritative: a pass is a hint, not a guarantee.
val.caveat_confirm: Validation was not authoritative: the real server may still reject this file (then the automatic rollback applies).
apply.ok: Applied. The new configuration is live and healthy.
apply.rollback_ok: Rolled back to the selected revision.
apply.unhealthy: Written, but the health check reports unhealthy.
apply.rolled_back_explain: The new configuration failed its health check, so the previous file was restored and the service restarted on it. Your edits are still in the editor so you can fix them.
conflict.title: The file changed on disk since you loaded it.
conflict.body: Nothing was written. Reload the current file and re-check your edits against it, or discard your edits.
conflict.discard: Discard my edits and load latest
conflict.rediffed: Reloaded the current file. Your edits are kept; review the diff and apply again.
hist.title: Revision history
hist.empty: No revisions yet. One is created before every write.
act.danger_destructive: Destructive: state is lost and cannot be recovered.
pg.title: Send a chat request through this system
pg.not_persisted: This conversation lives only in this page. It is proxied and streamed but never stored.
pg.unavailable_hint: This system does not offer a chat endpoint through the console.
relay.counts_hint: Counts come from the files Relay writes. Event content is never shown, only metadata.
dyn.metrics_unavailable: Metrics are unavailable while Dynamo is not serving.
dyn.chart_empty: No history for this metric yet.
dyn.preflight_note: Read-only check that runs before every up, down or restart.
dyn.go_dark: Router aliases that go dark while Dynamo holds the card
dyn.lifecycle_hint: Each button runs preflight first and then asks you to confirm the exact effect. These buttons start and stop only Dynamo's containers. Dynamo is opt-in: while an exclusive engine (the default model) holds the worker's card, Up is refused; switch with the start command shown in the Dynamo status instead.
dyn.effect_up: Starts the Dynamo frontend and worker.
dyn.effect_down: Stops the Dynamo frontend and worker.
dyn.effect_restart: Restarts the Dynamo frontend and worker.
dyn.confirm_refused: Up will be refused while {name} runs on the card: switch with the start command shown in the Dynamo status instead.
dyn.confirm_other_cards: Only Dynamo's containers are started or stopped (plus the one engine below, if you tick it).
dyn.stop_sharing: Also stop {name}, the opt-in engine on this card (required for Up while it runs)
dyn.stop_sharing_hint: Without this, Up is refused. Only that one container is stopped; the default model is never stopped from here.
params.title: Tunables
params.explain: Values are rendered into a compose override kept in the console state directory. The repository compose file is never edited; deleting the override reverts.
params.unsupported: This system exposes no tunable parameters.
params.restart_tip: Takes effect after the worker restarts
params.err_choice: Not one of the allowed choices
params.effect_restart: Writes the compose override and recreates the Dynamo worker, which reloads the model (a cold start takes about 4 minutes and interrupts serving).
params.effect_live: Writes the compose override. The changed parameters take effect without a restart.
params.confirm_override: The repository compose file is not modified.
audit.title: Mutating calls
audit.explain: Append-only record of every change made through the console. Parameters are redacted.
audit.admin_only_hint: The audit log is visible to admins only.
settings.bearer_set: A token is set for this tab
settings.bearer_hint: Kept in this tab's sessionStorage only. It is never written to localStorage.
settings.tokens_hint: Credentials are referenced by environment variable name on the server. Only their status is shown; values are never sent to the browser.
err.network: Cannot reach the console backend. Check that it is running on 127.0.0.1:8793 and that this page is served from it.
err.401: Authentication is required. Set a bearer token with the key button in the top bar.
err.403: Not allowed. Either your role is viewer, or the request was rejected as cross-origin. Open the console from its own address.
err.409: Conflict: the file changed since you loaded it, or the target is busy. Reload and review before retrying.
err.413: The request body is too large (limit 1 MiB; config files 256 KiB). Shorten it and retry.
err.415: The server refused the content type. Reload the page to get a matching client.
err.421: The Host header was rejected. Open the console at http://127.0.0.1:8793 or http://localhost:8793.
err.429: Too many requests or open streams. Wait a few seconds, close other console tabs, and retry.
err.502: The console could not reach the upstream system. Check its status on the Overview page.
err.503: The console or the upstream system is unavailable right now. Check the Overview page and retry shortly.
dyn.preflight_viewer: Preflight runs a check through the console and is admin-only. Ask an admin to run Up, Down or Restart.
settings.restart_required: A saved change only takes effect after the console backend restarts.
